request.description: Characterize the compiled two-joint arm, contractual singular reset, radius-angle inverse-kinematic conditioning, and deterministic one-interval unit-action responses at reset and representative feasible configurations.

measurements.label: compiled dynamics, kinematics, and known-action response

request.rationale: The initial scientific distinction is whether direct-torque control is materially constrained by compiled dynamics and singularity exit, or whether the more consequential gap is learned coverage and two-second stabilization. This candidate-free measurement directly tests the former without conflating it with policy quality. Strong, configuration-dependent acceleration, persistent post-impulse motion, or poor singularity-exit authority would justify dynamics-aware control and identification before interpreting a learning result; regular fast response with feasible, well-conditioned target branches would redirect the next action toward training and radius/angle/hold-stratified policy evaluation. The artifact records observations only and does not infer a conclusion.
